transcript: I think what was missing in a lot of these explanations was a description of more daily, like, more intimate things about people's lives, like families, communities, and how all of that functions. I think a lot of the focus was on economic structures, government structures, and while those are really important components of a society, I think that my ideal society would also include something that at least promoted a community-like structure where people care a lot about the people close to them. they care about their neighbors. We have families being like an incentive to have families and like just a family unit with like children and parents because I think that's a big part of having a stable society and also if you're looking to preserve the longevity of a society you need to make sure that we're able to reproduce at a certain rate.
